name: govee-lights-local
description: Private desktop control of your Govee lights, with a safe simulated demo by default.

interface.shortDescription: Control your own Govee lights privately
interface.longDescription: Unofficial single-household local MCP integration. Starts with simulated lights until you configure your own Govee key privately on this computer. Never asks for secrets in chat.
defaultPrompt: List my Govee lights and tell me whether demo mode is active.
